beginner.summary: For developers, testers and junior operations engineers who can build and run single containers with the Docker CLI and now need to run multi-container applications with Docker Compose v2. Covers the Compose Specification and compose.yaml, the docker compose command set, services, ports, named and bind volumes, project networks and service DNS, environment files and variable interpolation, depends_on with healthchecks, restart policies, building images from Compose, profiles, override files, logs and day-to-day debugging, and a three-service web application capstone.
prerequisites: Builds an image from a Dockerfile and runs it with docker run, -p, -v and -e
Reads and writes YAML with correct indentation, lists and mappings
Has Docker Desktop or Docker Engine with the docker compose plugin installed and permission to run containers
outcomes: Describe a multi-container application in compose.yaml and run, inspect and remove it with docker compose
Connect services over the project network, persist data in named volumes and publish only the ports that clients need
Configure services with .env files, environment and env_file, and order startup with depends_on and healthchecks
Use builds, profiles and compose.override.yaml to run the same project for development and testing
